answer: The willow escrow is released only against a wharf receipt, and the cipher audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 46 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 176 aliases means carrying 107 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
